No. 2138/9 – MONDAY, AUGUST, 26, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 07
My No.: B/E/3/Acquisitions/Malip/Canal - II.
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/9/2015/IR/220B.

IT is hereby notified under Section 07 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following Lands required for the construction of the canal line from the Malipoththa tank.
Description of the Land to be acquired:

Allotments of land in F.V.P.20 Supplement 14 Sheet No. 22 prepared by the superintendent of Surveyor in Monaragala, situated in Karagahawela East Village in Bibile Divisional Secretary’s Division of the District of Monaragala in Uva province described as follows:
